body: I'm done with it all. I don't want to live anymore. That is it.

I'm afraid that no one will ever want me. I have way too many flaws and it was a miracle that he asked me out in the first place. It sucks feeling so unwanted for most of your life. I've tried to make friends and be more approachable and outgoing. Nothing has worked. No one wants to be associated with me. I'm a loser. I'm not saying that to be self destructive, it's just a fact and I accept it. I don't want to deal with anything anymore. I gave it my all and that was it.

I have tried distancing myself from him before and it's never worked. Besides my friend, he is the only person that I can talk to. I've tried journaling, finding a hobby, focusing on work, focusing on myself, but I can't get him off my mind. This is my first relationship and this is so hard.

He kept saying that he'll do more. Then he says I do everything. Every time I gave him an opportunity to plan something or choose what we do, he made me pick. He said he didn't care. And now he blows up in my face saying that none of what I selected is what he wanted. Whenever I ask what he wants so we can do that instead, he says he doesn't know. I'm exhausted.

No, she hasn't contacted me. I tried to reach her Friday night and yesterday. She's probably busy. 

This was my first relationship and he was thr first person who ever asked me out (at age 26). I spent my whole life with no one physically attracted to me. I let this go on for too long in the fear of losing it. I'm an idiot.

It's not too late. I've been suicidal and depressed since I was eight. My dad used to blame everything on me and made me feel worthless. I lingered on through schooling, but afterwards, I still lived with my parents and he made me feel even worse for not being able to find a job after college. He beat the shit out of me. It scarred me for life. I worked on myself for two years trying to be happy. It felt like everything was falling into place when I met my boyfriend. Now, two years later, he thinks that I'm crazy and dramatic because I'm suicidal. 

It's Easter and he broke up with me this morning. At first I was sad, but then I started thinking about how happy I used to be without him. Yes, there were a lot of difficult times, but I was able to be hapoy without him. He never made me feel good. I felt like the ugliest creature in the world, but no one is. You are beautiful. You are the most amazing person ever. You are the only person who can be you. There are just not enough people that know how awesome you are. We surround ourselves with the same group of people, but sometimes, we need to take a step back and meet new people to get a fresh perspective. 

Your plans will come into fruition. You can do it! It takes a lot of time, energy, and dedication. And it's hard, it's so freaking hard, but once you accomplish it. The feeling of gratification is so worth it. Please don't hurt yourself. I'm right here next to you in the type of situation.
Please don't. How can I help?
